evidenceRole: Fresh confirmatory public method validation after D6 post-hoc mechanism work. LongMemEval-V2 has not been used to design or score D1-D6.

split.testReadRule: No test case or baseline output may be materialized before one development-selected policy passes the frozen validation gate and a committed admission artifact exists.

baseline.engine: MemoryCore SQLite L0 FTS5 through executeConversationSearch
baseline.queryTransform: Remove final-answer formatting instructions only; retain the substantive question and options.

challenger.memoryForm: Baseline raw windows plus bounded deterministic pre/action/post transition-diff units above the unchanged MemoryCore FTS5 engine.

selfOptimization.selectionRule: Select exactly one policy on development. Validation can accept or reject it but cannot choose another policy. Test can be read once only after validation admission.
selfOptimization.evolutionBoundary: Only the bounded transition index and the 18 frozen retrieval-budget policies evolve. FTS5, embeddings, extraction models, labels, and answer generation remain unchanged.

directMetric.definition: Split the official phrase-set reference answer with its official separators, apply lower-case, hyphen and punctuation normalization, and count an atom only when the normalized atom occurs in an injected memory unit.
directMetric.scopeWarning: This is answer-support evidence, not gold retrieval recall: the public data has no question-to-trajectory attribution, occurrence can be coincidental, and absence does not prove that a reader cannot infer the answer.

aggregation.sharedHaystackSensitivity: Report enterprise and web separately because each domain shares one haystack.
aggregation.bootstrap: paired stratified question bootstrap by domain

answerLevelGate.judging: Blind arm labels, deterministic order randomization, both providers, no OpenRouter dependency.
answerLevelGate.claimBoundary: Direct support can admit an answer-level experiment; it cannot by itself establish task accuracy.
